title: QA Tester Result v1
description: Structured verdict written by qa-tester after verifying a GitHub issue's acceptance criteria. Orchestrator reads this to decide whether to re-route fixes to dev agents or proceed to pr-reviewer.

verdict.description: PASS — all ACs verified, no regressions. PARTIAL — some ACs unverified due to missing fixture / data (not tooling); orchestrator may still proceed at its discretion. INTERACTIVE-REQUIRED — static + bash-smoke ACs pass, but one or more ACs require MCP-driven interactive verification (Playwright web / XcodeBuildMCP iOS) that the sub-agent's tool surface cannot perform. The orchestrator picks up the interactive checks on the main thread before the code-review gate. FAIL — at least one AC actively broken, or a regression detected.

ac.description: Verbatim AC bullet from issue body.

evidence.description: One-line evidence: test name, screenshot path, log line, etc.

i18n_check.description: Whether new user-facing copy lands in cs/en/de. n/a when issue has no UI strings.

prototype_fidelity_check.description: Whether the rendered UI matches docs/prototypes/<package>/scenes/*.html. n/a for non-UI issues.
